note: Rules that transition width/height with NO mount animation, accepted deliberately. Two kinds live here and they are not the same thing. (1) CORRECT: the transition responds to a real later change, so there is a previous value and a mount animation would be wrong. (2) DEAD: a bar fill with motion carefully written on it that no JSX renders — every one of these is also held in orphan-selectors-baseline.json. A dead entry must NOT be animated; animating a rule nothing renders is the ixFadeUp defect. The fix for those is deletion, and it has to convert the JSX first because check-classes fails on a class used but not declared. Shrink this file; do not grow it.

src/styles/components.css|.tabs__ind.reason: The OTHER tab strip's indicator, and it already slides: one shared element transitioning left and width between tabs. It has a previous position by definition. This is the pattern .mt__ind was rebuilt to match — see module.css.

src/styles/editorial.css|.side.reason: The sidebar collapsing and expanding. A real state change with a real previous width; a mount animation would make the sidebar grow out of nothing on every page load.

src/styles/editorial.css|.side__loz.reason: The sidebar's active lozenge, which travels between nav items on transform + height. Same shape as .tabs__ind: it moves, so it always has a previous value.

src/styles/module.css|.mt__ind.reason: The module tab indicator, rebuilt this pass as one shared travelling element. Its width transition is the whole point. Its ENTRANCE is an animation, but on .mt__ind::after rather than .mt__ind — the parent's transform carries the travel and an animation on the same element would overwrite it — and this gate matches selectors exactly, so the pseudo does not satisfy the parent.

src/styles/brand.css|.k-progress-fill.reason: No JSX renders .k-progress-fill. Held in orphan-selectors-baseline.json. Delete, do not animate.

src/styles/editorial.css|.k-stat__bar-fi.reason: No JSX renders .k-stat__bar-fill, and it is declared TWICE — here and in kartavaya-design.css. Held in orphan-selectors-baseline.json. Delete both, do not animate.
